annotations.title: Everything for one launch in one call

description: One call that answers "what will the water be like at this spot?": the nearest tide station with 2 days of highs and lows, currents nearby, the next 24 h of wind, gusts and waves with the maxima, warnings in effect, water temperature and sunrise/sunset, with the important heads_up lines listed first.

from.description: First day as YYYY-MM-DD in the station's time zone (default today). Free keys reach 7 days ahead of today.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), negative west of Greenwich.
